name: Hardback book
definition: book bound in rigid boards (ONIX BB, trade cloth, relié); `binding` (trade cloth, library or reinforced binding, leather or fine binding) and `format_size` are attributes.
notes: BN: hardcover called Trade Cloth; ONIX BB hardback or cased book.

name: Paperback book
definition: book bound in a flexible paper cover (ONIX BC, broché, poche), trade and mass-market alike; `trim_class` and `paper_class` are attributes.
notes: BN: paperback and mass-market paperback sold as formats; ONIX BC.

name: Spiral-bound book
definition: book whose leaves are held by a wire or plastic spiral or comb (ONIX BE).
notes: BN spiral binding with wire or plastic coil; ONIX BE.

name: Loose-leaf book
definition: book issued as punched loose leaves held in a ring binder or post binding (ONIX BD).
notes: Loose Leaf binding label on Pearson and McGraw Hill listings; ONIX BD.

name: Pamphlet or booklet, stapled
definition: short publication of a few sheets bound by staples or saddle-stitching (ONIX BF).
notes: ONIX BF: pamphlet, stapled; comic floppies also coded BF. No shop page fetched.

name: Board book
definition: book printed on thick laminated paperboard pages, made for young children (ONIX BH).
notes: Bookshop.org tags Board book; ONIX BH.

name: Rag, bath or foam book
definition: book with pages of cloth, waterproof plastic or foam, made for babies (ONIX BI, BJ, BP).
notes: Rag book and Bath book tagged separately; AAT bath books waterproof, foam-filled; ONIX BI BJ BP.

name: Sewing or knitting pattern (paper)
definition: printed single-pattern sheet or envelope for sewing or knitting, issued as a loose sheet rather than bound (R-42; memo kind 7a; provisional until attested); craft, size range and garment made are attributes.
notes: eBay paper sewing patterns category: Vogue Patterns, Simplicity, Butterick, McCall.

name: Single-issue comic
definition: saddle-stitched comic issue of one serial number (the "floppy"; ONIX pamphlet).
notes: Single issues ("floppies"); ONIX BF covers comic floppies.

name: Collected softcover volume
definition: softcover volume collecting several issues or chapters of a comic or manga (trade paperback, tankōbon; label_source: memo).
notes: Trade paperbacks; tankobon collect serialized manga chapters.

name: Collected hardcover volume
definition: hardcover volume collecting several issues or chapters (label_source: memo).
notes: Hardcovers: collected editions with cardboard covers.

name: Omnibus or compendium
definition: thick single volume collecting a long run of issues or several collected volumes; `binding` is an attribute.
notes: Omnibuses and compendiums listed as separate formats; Dark Horse/Image omnibus softcovers, IDW compendium.

name: Pocket-size reissue
definition: small-format reprint edition of a comic or manga already issued in collected volumes (bunkoban; label_source: memo).
notes: Bunkoban A6, thicker with fewer volumes than tankobon.

name: Premium large-format edition
definition: oversized deluxe edition on large trim and heavier paper (Absolute, kanzenban; label_source: memo).
notes: Absolute, Gallery, Deluxe, Artist Edition; kanzenban A5 and soshuhen B5.

name: Newspaper
definition: periodical issued daily or weekly on unbound newsprint sheets; `page_format` (broadsheet, Berliner, tabloid) is an attribute.
notes: Broadsheet, tabloid, Berliner newspaper formats; Fujisan lists newspapers.

name: Magazine
definition: periodical issue bound as a stapled or perfect-bound paper-covered booklet, digest-size magazines included; `page_format` is an attribute.
notes: Print magazines sold at Fujisan; digest-size magazines named.

name: Bound periodical volume
definition: book-form volume binding together a run of issues of one periodical (filed with periodicals against HS, F-8).
notes: Four issues of The Connoisseur 1902 bound in one half-leather volume, sold by Common Crow Books.

name: Zine or fanzine
definition: small self-published or fan-made periodical, usually photocopied or short-run and stapled.
notes: Zine distro and shop sells zines; defines zine as self-published small-circulation booklet.

name: Full score
definition: printed score showing every part of an ensemble work on the page at full size.
notes: Full score shows all instruments or voices; SMP format Score.

name: Miniature (study) score
definition: full score reduced to pocket size for study (pocket score, Studienpartitur).
notes: Miniature, pocket or study score; Studienpartitur sold; series list of pocket scores.

name: Vocal or piano-vocal score
definition: score with the vocal parts in full and the accompaniment reduced for piano.
notes: Vocal score with piano reduction; Novello Messiah vocal score.

name: Score and parts
definition: score issued together with the separate parts for each performer.
notes: SMP format Score and Parts; Illinois parts may include score and separate parts.

name: Set of parts
definition: the separate performers' parts of a work issued without the score.
notes: SMP format Set of Parts.

name: Choral octavo
definition: single choral work printed in octavo format for choir use.
notes: SMP format Octavo; page does not say choral.

name: Songbook or collection
definition: bound collection of songs or pieces, in notation for voice, piano or another instrument, lead-sheet books included.
notes: SMP format Collection / Songbook.

name: Folded map
definition: printed map sheet folded to pocket size for carrying; `scope` is an attribute.
notes: Folded maps compact and portable; Stanfords folded map product.

name: Wall map
definition: map printed or mounted to hang flat on a wall, laminated or not.
notes: Stanfords Wall Maps category; laminated 3-sheet wall map.

name: Map booklet
definition: map issued as a small stapled or bound booklet of map sections.
notes: Map booklets: multi-page collections of bound maps.

name: Bound atlas, hard or soft cover
definition: book of maps bound in boards, a flexible cover or flexi-binding; `scope` is an attribute.
notes: Stanfords Atlases menu; France AA Traveller's Atlas (Flexi-bound).

name: Spiral-bound atlas
definition: book of maps held by a wire or plastic spiral so it lies flat (road atlases).
notes: Spiral Bound road atlases (Philip's, AA, A-Z A3).

name: Desktop globe
definition: globe on a short base or stand made to sit on a desk or table, mini globes included.
notes: Replogle desktop globes category, 137 results; mini versions exist.

name: Floor globe
definition: globe on a tall floor-standing stand or frame.
notes: Floor globes with stand; Replogle Sherbrooke II foot-stand model.

name: Hanging or suspended globe
definition: globe made to hang from a ceiling or bracket.
notes: Replogle suspension globe hung from cast-iron pendant mount.
